Records.description: Nonplanar 3-loop massless propagator MI (6 vertices, 8 edges). Computed via GPXT. Epsilon expansion through $\varepsilon^2$ in MZVs to weight 7. The $\varepsilon^2$ coefficient obtained numerically via PSLQ.

Three-loop non-planar crossed scalar propagator-type diagram $\tilde{B}^{(3)}(k^2)$ with massless internal lines. Called $\tilde{B}^{(3)}$ in the paper. Obtained by inserting the closed form $\tilde{C}^{(2)} = (C^{(1)})^2$ into a remaining one-loop box integration, reproducing $20\zeta(5)$: $\tilde{B}^{(3)}(k^2) = (i\pi^2)^3/(k^2)^2 \cdot 20\zeta(5)$. Same formula holds for the planar three-loop propagator.

Records.authors: Piotr Bargiela, Fabrizio Caola, Andreas von Manteuffel, Lorenzo Tancredi
Records.description: Three-loop NPL1 bare scalar (all unit propagator powers) imported from arXiv:2111.13595 ancillary i2m IBP reduction (sector 29125; 22 master(s)). One off-shell external leg P^2 = MM, the other external legs on-shell massless; single-scale (x-free, immune to the t/u variable choice). D=4-2eps all-unit-power scalar, leading finite (eps^0 leading). Stored in the e^{+i pi} branch (library-native). Its eps^0 value 20*zeta(5)/MM^2 coincides with the known Usyukina-Davydychev crossed-propagator constant referenced in this entry's literature Records; this import provides the FIRST machine-readable, crit-3-validated Laurent series for it (the home previously held only symbol-level proposals plus literature citations, with no stored series).
